events.title: Steamboat Kids Ski Free Month — Free Lift Tickets Without Adult Purchase (Nov 21–Dec 15, 2026)
events.time: Daytime resort lift operations; actual open lifts and hours depend on snow conditions
events.location: Steamboat Ski Resort, Steamboat Springs, Colorado
events.cost: $0 per child aged 12 and under for lift tickets, NO adult ticket purchase required in this limited window; for 2 adults + 3 eligible children the 3 children's lift tickets total $0. Adult lift tickets, equipment, lessons, transport and lodging extra, full 5-person cost unknown.
events.age: Children aged 12 or younger eligible for free individual-day lift tickets. Any age may accompany with appropriate paid lift ticket; no membership/residency or adult ticket purchase required for child offer.
events.description: Official resort promotion for November 21 through December 15, 2026 only: select '12 and Under Kids Ski Free Nov. 21 - Dec.15, 2026' on the resort's lift-ticket checkout to add a $0 child ticket; separate single-day tickets needed for more than one day. Different from the regular Kids Ski Free offer requiring 5+ paid adult days. Strong non-routine savings: three qualifying children receive $0 lift tickets without any adult-ticket purchase. Limited to 2026 local residents, outside the family's June 2027–August 2028 stay. Online checkout was inaccessible (HTTP 403) during this research, so remaining ticket inventory, adult pricing, weather-dependent opening, and final total are unverified. Official page FAQ mistakenly mentions year 2025 once, while promotion headline, instructions and purchase-eligibility FAQ explicitly say 2026.
